scope: Production v0.5 layout, DirectWrite rendering, action dispatch, menu construction, preference persistence and time-based animation components; own render buffers only.

checks.name: missing settings use documented defaults

duplicate preference keys fail to defaults
oversized settings are bounded and rejected
light settings saved for rendering
failed preference write retains the current in-memory learning choice
isolated host without a settings path retains memory-only preferences
next page enters from right and fades in for 180 ms
outgoing page exits left and is gone at 120 ms
rapid reverse paging replaces rather than queues motion
learning collapse interpolates height for 240 ms
English fades out within 160 ms
rapid learning reversal starts at current height
reduced motion applies both state changes immediately
five two-line candidates and toolbar measure 600 by 55 DIP
outer corners are transparent and body is opaque
English and Chinese rows share the same candidate hit target
ordinary English-row action selects Chinese candidate independent of highlight
previous-page boundary is disabled without dispatch
next-page tool dispatches the existing page callback
learning tool requests a versioned toggle without selection
more tool uses the current candidate index
last page keeps width and toolbar coordinates
current page and hit targets switch before animation ends
outgoing candidates are absent from accessible names
returning to previous page retains fixed width
learning-off immediately removes English accessibility during animation
learning-off ends at 38 DIP without changing width
missing study capability disables study controls but retains Chinese selection
invalidated snapshot cannot dispatch a stale pointer action
new single-candidate composition uses a short bar
long Chinese expands its cell while English retains its full source value
DPI 96 scales geometry and preserves both-line hit regions
DPI 120 scales geometry and preserves both-line hit regions
DPI 144 scales geometry and preserves both-line hit regions
DPI 192 scales geometry and preserves both-line hit regions
narrow work area constrains a single row without shrinking type

limits: No Computer Use or physical mouse/keyboard acceptance
No Windows display-setting changes or multi-monitor desktop acceptance
No installation or input method registration
Component callbacks alone do not establish TSF document edits; separate native-v05-tsf report covers those
